title: Topological Generalization Benchmark: Linear Deep vs Wide Fan-out vs High-Reuse Mesh
goal: Empirically test whether the local maintenance advantage of AINL+LIN generalizes across 3 distinct graph topologies (Linear Deep, Wide Fan-out, and High-Reuse Diamond Mesh) under 60 mutations.

topologies.name: Linear Deep Pipeline
topologies.description: Strictly sequential processing chain with extreme transitive depth

topologies.name: Wide Fan-Out Tree
topologies.description: Shallow hierarchy with massive parallel branch fan-out

topologies.name: High-Reuse Diamond Mesh
topologies.description: Dense diamond DAG where intermediate nodes are shared by multiple downstream paths
